note: A reference set of writing with craft credibility, used to derive empirical ranges for the stylometry thresholds rather than inventing them. Selection encodes a particular taste and is meant to be edited: swap in whoever you actually admire. Text is NOT stored in this repository - build_corpus.py fetches to a gitignored cache and commits only derived metrics.
selection_criteria: freely readable on the open web, no paywall circumvention
prose whose craft is widely and independently regarded, not merely popular
spans registers: technical explanation, reported nonfiction, criticism, personal essay, business writing
living or recent, so the register is usable rather than archival
